 News Carson Daly Shares How He’s Feeling Ahead of New Saturday TODAY Gig: ‘Overwhelmed, But Mostly Incredibly Grateful’
 Carson is permanently joining Laura Jarrett as a co-anchor on the weekend show starting Nov. 7. Nov. 6, 2026, 7:53 PM EST / Source : TODAY Ariana Brockington
 Trending News Reporter
 Carson Daly is Named Co-Anchor of Saturday TODAY 03:18 Share Add TODAY to Google Carson Daly is opening up about how is feeling a day before he begins a “new chapter” at TODAY.
 It was announced Nov. 5 that Carson will permanently join Laura Jarrett as co-anchor of Saturday TODAY . Ahead of his first weekend episode, which will air Nov. 7, he shared a post on Instagram about his new role and revealed the gift he seemingly received from TODAY co-anchor Savannah Guthrie. 
 “Maybe slightly overwhelmed, but mostly incredibly grateful for all the well wishes & kind thoughts for my new Sat @todayshow gig,” he wrote in his caption. “A new chapter, a new challenge, and a new opportunity to get better at what I love to do. I’m ready for it.”
 He added that the support he has received from members of the NBC News family since the announcement was made has meant a lot to him. 
 “I hope to do you proud. It’ll be a process, gotta lot to learn & it all starts live tomorrow am with my partner @laurajarrett Cya then!” he said and included a tongue-out emoji. 
 The post included a picture of a bottle of Blanton’s bourbon whisky and a handwritten note seemingly from Savannah. “For the Anchorman. So proud. Love Savannah,” she said. 
 Other members of the TODAY and NBC News family wished him well in the comments. 
 Laura wrote, “So many good times ahead—bourbon, gummies and Levain included.”
 Vicky Nguyen added, “Bring it home for our generation Carson! The one constant in everyone’s life- Carson Daly on a TV broadcast … now almost daily!”
 Former NBC News correspondent Janet Shamlian said, “This is what my Saturday morning has been missing, @carsondaly.” 
 Shop TODAY’s Adrianna Brach commented, “Bonbon and Blanton’s!! You got this @carsondaly !!!!” 
 Carson had been appearing as an interim co-anchor on Saturday TODAY with Laura since September. When he revealed earlier this week he would officially become her co-anchor, he confirmed he will still be a part of TODAY’s regular weekday broadcasts. 
 “I should just say, I’ve been very lucky to have a lot of TV gigs, but this one’s really special,” he said after making the announcement. “At my age and at my stage of my career, to have an opportunity to come in and sit next to Laura and to learn and to get better at my job, to be the best broadcaster that I can, it’s not something I take lightly.”
 Marc J. Franklin for TODAY Along with Laura, Carson will join feature anchor Joe Fryer and meteorologist Angie Lassman, as well. 
 Carson continued, “We’re going to have a lot of fun on Saturday. But most importantly, the best part about the gig, like here during the week — which I’ll still be here during the week — is getting to go to your place of employment with such high-quality human beings. We are a family, and the fact that I get to spend one more day in this building, six days a week, is an absolute honor.”
 To celebrate, the TODAY family shared a Guinness toast. Savannah also praised Carson for making “every segment he’s in pop” and shared he is “like a brother” to her. “You bring so much love and light, and I am so happy,” she said when reacting to his new position. 
 Laura added, “We’re going to have so much fun.”
 Carson replaces Peter Alexander, who left the show in March and departed NBC News after 22 years. He is currently a host at MS NOW. 
 Carson has been with TODAY since 2013. He delights viewers each episode with his pop culture and celebrity news during the PopStart segment. 
 Carson is permanently joining Laura Jarrett as a co-anchor on the weekend show starting Nov. 7. 
 Share Add TODAY to Google Ariana Brockington Ariana Brockington is a trending news reporter at TODAY digital. She is based in Los Angeles.
